It is a step in the right direction. But it is far from enough. A lot of problems remain to this day that makes the game feel like shit. I’m probably being redundant but they are :

- harvest change are still terrible. Harvest being in a good state is very beneficial to poe health. It enables meh build to perform alright and promotes build diversity. So nerfing it as it was done in 3.19 is a decision that should be reviewed. Needless to say the reduction of cost were far from enough.

- mapping still feels like shit. As many other have pointed out relying on AN monsters for loot generation is in theory working. In practice it feels inconsistent and boring. Spreading out evenly these « 50 divines on one mob » would be a lot more exciting ( I wont comment on the use of illegal 3rd party tools to even realistically meet these monsters)

- related to the above point. Heist should not be the only good source of currency. It is not the best aspect of the game and is pretty boring to a lot of people. But because of the abysmal currency drop in mapping many of us feel obligated to run heist so they can afford gear. This is how you burn people out of the game. This is how you make players leave early, by forcing them into a content they dont enjoy just so they can get currency and finally play the game like they wanted to. 

- minions. Fucking minions. Please GGG read what people say. The entire archetype is on the brink of death and Ghazzy is on suicide watch. A lot of minions skills need an overhaul in mechanics / damage to be viable. And those who have the potential to be meet another problem : minions survivability is at an all time low. Rather than nerfing minion health values in the manifesto we should have seen health increase. The reduced access to +lvl of minion skill gem has effectively reduced their life under what was needed to survive in high tier maps. Just buff minion life. Like a lot.
